resource.platformNotes: macOS 13+, Apple Silicon or Intel. No independent rendering, guild-compliance or Resolve-import test.

requirements.dependencies: Online account/review features have separate network use; master rendering is local.

evidence.note: macOS 13+, Apple Silicon or Intel. No independent rendering, guild-compliance or Resolve-import test.

Standalone end-credit design and rendering companion for film/TV, exporting ProRes 4444 alpha, DNxHR, DPX, EXR and other deliverables for finishing. Masters render on the Mac; document intake and online team review have separate workflows. Watermarked exports are free; clean masters need a production/season license or subscription. Exact Resolve host requirements are not applicable to rendering independent plates.
